learned_route.purpose: authorize or reject R1 P1 design only; not promotion

nested_development.candidate_selection: minimize total YOLO inner guardrail violation, then hit deficit, false-alert excess, clearance deficit, maximize hits, minimize false alerts, maximize cleared, then config_id and threshold ascending
nested_development.event_contribution: exactly one outer-fold score per parent event
nested_development.fold_assignment: within each exact bucket sort parent_event_id ascending and assign (zero-based position + frozen bucket offset) modulo 5; every outer fold has exactly 6 events
nested_development.group_unit: source session / parent event; manifest has one event per session
nested_development.selection_scope: each arm selects independently on the 24 inner events; seed 20260801 remains the fixed decision seed
nested_development.warning: nesting reduces direct item-level tuning leakage but does not restore freshness
